ada: here's the improved Python snippet I'm pasting into the PR (feel free to shorten):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
model = client.model("redwood/long-context-4k", quant_profile="q4_0")

# prefetch common prompt prefix into the runtime KV cache for later requests
model.prefetch_kv(cache_key="onboarding_v1", prefix="System: You are a helpful assistant.\n")

prompts = ["User: summarize the document...", "User: extract bullets from..."]
# adaptive batching + batch size hint; runtime can merge smaller requests
resp = model.generate_batch(prompts, batch_size=4, adaptive_batching=True, max_tokens=256)
for r in resp:
    print(r.text)
```
